The problem

Savings sit in cash while jargon, fear and scams keep people out

AED 100,000 kept in cash buys only AED 74,000

worth of goods after 10 years at 3% inflation. A silent loss of about a quarter.

01

Confusing jargon

P/E, dividend yield, volatility: no plain explanation of what they mean

02

Resources that don’t fit

Too technical, made for younger users, little in plain Arabic

03

Fear and feeling too late

Worried one wrong move costs hard-earned savings

04

Nowhere to turn

Tips from WhatsApp groups and social media expose them to scams

Problem evidence

The problem is widespread, and time is running out for this age group

38%

of UAE adults are financially literate

S&P Global FinLit
45%

of residents haven’t started saving for retirement

Friends Provident, 2022
56%

face a scam attempt at least monthly, mostly via WhatsApp

UAE Cybersecurity Council, 2024
40,000+

residents lost hundreds of millions of dollars to fake schemes

Khaleej Times

Why now: many plan to retire before 60, leaving 5–15 years to prepare. Every year in cash loses growth they can never get back, and the UAE Ministry of Interior warned of investment scams again in October 2026.

Target customer

UAE residents aged 40–60 with savings, goals and little investing knowledge

A

Ahmed, 52

Emirati government manager

Wants to retire comfortably. Needs clear Arabic explanations, without being talked down to.

P

Priya, 46

Indian expat, hospital department head

Saving for her children’s university. Needs simple strategies and the inflation calculator, in English.

F

Fatima, 58

Emirati pre-retiree

Protecting savings in the bank. Needs a scam check, practice account, large text and family mode.

The job to be done: grow savings safely for retirement, children’s education and family, by understanding a stock’s numbers instead of relying on tips, and feeling confident, not foolish.

Solution

A translator between the stock market and everyday investors

1

Awareness

An inflation calculator shows, in their own numbers, what idle cash loses over time.

2

Understanding

Tap any metric for a plain explanation, a UAE analogy and the sector’s normal range, at three depth levels.

3

Action

Step-by-step strategy guides, then a virtual-money practice account to try them with no risk.

Example

P/E ratio = how many years of rent it takes to pay back the villa you bought.

Education only: we never say what to buy or sell.

Key features

Everything a cautious first-time investor needs, in one place

Built for 40–60: large text, read-aloud, Arabic and English, and family mode so grown children can help.

Technology

A grounded AI layer on licensed data, with safety built in

Tech stack
  • React Native app for iOS and Android, with Arabic right-to-left
  • Supabase or Firebase for accounts and practice portfolios
  • AI model grounded in a checked glossary, not free text
  • Licensed ADX and DFM market data, time-stamped
  • UAE-region cloud hosting and read-aloud voice
What we own
  • UAE analogy library: bilingual analogies for every metric
  • Sector range engine: turns each number into low, typical or high
  • Three-level framework: simple, intermediate and professional
  • Advice guardrail: blocks buy or sell suggestions before users see them

Business model

One honest subscription: we earn nothing from what users buy

AED 24.99a month

or AED 249 a year after a 14-day free trial. One tier with everything included.

A saver with AED 100,000 in cash loses about AED 250 a month to inflation. We cost a tenth of that.

Growth lines

Banks and brokers embed our layer: annual licence plus a fee per active user

Backup · Go-to-market

Consumer first to prove understanding, then banks and brokers

Minute 0

Download, via family, search or a licensed creator

Minutes 1–3

Four onboarding questions

Minutes 3–5

Guided tour of a real stock page

Minutes 5–10

Inflation calculator: the moment it clicks

Days 1–13

Daily digest, quiz and practice

Day 14

They decide to subscribe

Why B2C first: banks will embed us on evidence, not on a student team’s word. Users generate before-and-after understanding scores.

Low-cost channels: Ajman University and DoF workshops, employers’ HR sessions, and students bringing their parents through family mode.

Backup · Risks and mitigation

We know the weak spots, and each has a plan

RiskMitigation
Demand is unvalidated20 structured interviews in Ajman before building
Free AI chatbots can explain screenshotsLicensed data, SCA-verified checks and sector norms a chatbot can’t guarantee
Trust falls after 55 (57 → 41)Focus on 40–55 first; reach 55+ through family mode
Understanding may not lead to actionA virtual-money practice account as the bridge
Explaining could be read as adviceWritten content policy, advice guardrail and SCA guidance before launch
